question: Should OpenClaw adopt one shared stateful reasoning-tag tokenizer before landing this repair, or explicitly accept the bounded duplicate-parser grammar for this bug fix?
rationale: The remaining choice defines the permanent ownership and malformed/quoted-input contract across complete and streamed delivery; it cannot be resolved safely as a mechanical contributor follow-up.

options.title: Adopt a shared tokenizer
options.body: Create one stateful tag-recognition owner and migrate both complete and streaming consumers so identical input receives identical visibility treatment.

options.title: Accept the bounded repair
options.body: Merge the narrow depth-neutral handling only after explicitly accepting its separate-parser grammar limits and reviewing direct after-fix behavior proof.

options.title: Pause for ownership design
options.body: Keep this PR open while a narrower canonical implementation is designed or prepared against current main.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared tokenizer
recommendation.body: Create one stateful tag-recognition owner and migrate both complete and streaming consumers so identical input receives identical visibility treatment.
